name: Red Velvet Bakery
description:
Every love story is different, just as every proposal and wedding will be. At Red Velvet Bakery it is our pleasure to help bring to life the day you both dreamed of. 

From our initial consultation, cake tasting and design session, to delivery and set up at your chosen wedding venue, we will make sure that every detail is taken care of.

name: Aspire Fine Jewellery Limited
description:
We are a family-run jewellers, based on the border of Leicestershire & Nottinghamshire with over 15 years of experience, specialising in the design and creation of wedding rings, engagement rings, and eternity rings. Alongside our bespoke services, we also offer a beautiful selection of jewellery.

What makes us unique is our FREE home wedding ring service.

name: KDS Calligraphy
description:
Kayleigh is a calligrapher from the midlands  creating bespoke wedding stationery and signage to suit your individual love story. 

All of Kayleigh’s signs are hand-painted and handwritten and stationery items are enhanced with the beauty of modern calligraphy which brings a distinctive, personal touch to every celebration.
